The Axion is one of the better assault rifles in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, but it still needs the best possible loadout if you want to succeed with it in multiplayer. The Axion is a reliable choice for players that’s great at medium and long ranges, being more of a traditional AR. However, equipping the right attachments is still needed to get the most out of the Axion in Modern Warfare 4.
Below, you can find our recommended Axion loadout to use in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.
Key Takeaways
The Axion is a balanced assault rifle in Modern Warfare 4 that doesn’t have too many weaknesses in multiplayer.
There are several ways to build the Axion loadout, but improving recoil control and damage range is the best approach.
The Axion is best suited for players who prefer a traditional assault rifle playstyle in MW4.
Table of contents
Key Takeaways
Best loadout for the Axion in Modern Warfare 4
Best class setup for the Axion in Modern Warfare 4
Best loadout for the Axion in Modern Warfare 4
The Axion is a solid all-around assault rifle, so we really don’t have to focus on a single key area with its loadout. However, as with most balanced ARs in multiplayer, like the Patriot XMR, you’ll want to boost damage range and recoil control before anything else so you can compete with other meta weapons at range. Of course, you also need some extra mobility to handle SMGs at close range.
Here’s our recommended loadout for the Axion:
Muzzle: FTAC Dominion
Barrel: SA DMN-L 30″
Optic: Slimline Elite
Stock: Cronen Blackstone-6P

The Axion loadout in MW4. Screenshot by esports.gg
This is one of the better all-around loadouts in all of Modern Warfare 4, as it makes the Axion better in every way. You see a massive damage range and bullet velocity buff with the barrel, extra recoil control from the muzzle and stock, and added mobility from the rear grip.
We’ve equipped the Slimline Elite as it’s the best red dot sight in multiplayer, but you can switch it out with something else based on your preferences.

The Patriot XMR is one of the harder-hitting rifles available in Modern Warfare 4, making it an excellent choice for players who prefer taking enemies down from medium and long distances. However, you need some specific attachments to get the most out of the Patriot XMR.
Below, you can see the best Patriot XMR loadout to use in Modern Warfare 4 multiplayer.

The Patriot XMR is a powerful assault rifle in Modern Warfare 4, but needs specific attachments to control.
You can build the Patriot XMR in a number of ways, but maximizing recoil control is the best route to take.
The Patriot XMR is best served as a traditional, mid-range AR in Modern Warfare 4.

items.title: Take-Two Adds Billions in Market Value as GTA 6 Launches, Shares Close Up 6%
items.content:
Take-Two Interactive added billions of dollars to its stock market value on 18 November as Grand Theft Auto VI began rolling out worldwide. The publisher’s shares closed at $216.54, up 6.18% on the day, after rising as much as 8.8% during trading. The closing gain was worth about $2.4 billion in market value, and the rise briefly topped $3 billion at the intraday peak.
The rally lifted Take-Two’s market capitalisation from about $38.2 billion at Tuesday’s close to more than $40.5 billion during Wednesday’s session. Trading was unusually heavy, with around 12 million shares changing hands, roughly four times the stock’s recent daily average.
How Take-Two shares moved on GTA 6 launch day
Take-Two finished Tuesday at $203.93 and opened Wednesday’s session at $212.64, already well above the previous close. Buyers pushed the stock to a high of $222.65 during the morning, before it eased in the afternoon to settle at $216.54. The day’s low of $210.50 still sat comfortably above Tuesday’s closing price.
The opening jump followed the review embargo, as the first GTA 6 reviews lifted Take-Two shares soon after the market opened in New York. Take-Two outpaced the wider market throughout the day, with the Nasdaq 100 tracking fund QQQ up only around 0.3% and the S&P 500 fund SPY slightly lower.
The gain also recovered much of a sharp slide earlier in the week. Take-Two had fallen about 10% over the two trading days before launch, as some investors sold ahead of the release. Even after Wednesday’s rally, the stock remains down around 14% for the year and well short of its 52 week high of about $266.
Why investors bought into the GTA 6 launch
Early sales estimates gave investors the clearest reason to buy. Research firm Sensor Tower said GTA 6 had sold about 17.07 million units, worth around $1.65 billion, on launch day. That is more than double the $800 million GTA 5 made in its first 24 hours in 2013, which itself set records at the time.
Preorders had already pointed to a large opening. Sensor Tower counted about 15.88 million digital preorders worth roughly $1.54 billion as of 17 November, and Take-Two had earned $1.18 billion from GTA 6 before launch on earlier estimates. The game launched only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with no PC version announced.
Critical reception added to the momentum. GTA 6 opened with a 99 Metacritic score, tying the highest score on the site, as covered in the GTA 6 reviews roundup. Audience interest was equally strong, and GTA 6 set a new launch viewership record with more than 7.1 million peak viewers across Twitch, YouTube and Kick.
What analysts expect from GTA 6
Wall Street remains largely positive on Take-Two. Oppenheimer kept an Outperform rating and a $280 price target on launch day, and set GTA 6’s bar at 20 million copies and more than $1.85 billion in gross revenue over the first three days. BMO Capital Markets has a $285 target on the stock.
Benchmark analyst Mike Hickey has previously called Take-Two his top idea in entertainment and digital media, with a Buy rating and a $300 target. He described GTA 6 and the expected growth of GTA Online as a major catalyst, arguing the game’s hype cycle could be among the largest in entertainment history.
Not every signal is positive. Recent layoffs at Take-Two’s Firaxis studio and mixed second quarter results have weighed on sentiment, and some investors question whether launch demand can beat the company’s existing guidance. Take-Two also carries weight in several funds, making up around 5% of the Communication Services Select Sector SPDR fund, so its swings now ripple into wider portfolios.
What comes next for Take Two
The launch ends years of uncertainty that dragged on the share price. GTA 6 was first planned for autumn 2025, moved to May 2026 and finally arrived on 19 November, with each delay hitting the stock. Investors will now watch for official sell through numbers, which Take-Two typically reports in its earnings releases.
The company’s next earnings report is expected around 9 February 2027, and it will be the first to include GTA 6’s launch quarter. Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser marked the release with a rare public message, as Houser broke his silence on launch week to thank players. Take-Two publishes official results and investor updates on its investor relations page.
The post Take-Two Adds Billions in Market Value as GTA 6 Launches, Shares Close Up 6% appeared first on TalkEsport.

items.title: Rockstar Explains Why GTA 6 Has No Prostitutes In It, A Hallmark Of The Series Since 2001
How to Unlock Lucia in GTA 6: When She Becomes Playable and How to Switch
items.content:
Lucia Caminos is one of Grand Theft Auto VI’s two protagonists, but players control her only briefly at the very start of the game. After the prologue, the story switches to Jason Duval, and Lucia disappears from the playable cast for a long stretch of Chapter 1. Many players have spent their first hours in Leonida wondering when she returns.
Getting Lucia back involves two separate steps. Her release from prison happens partway through Chapter 1, but she does not become fully playable, or switchable, until later in the story.
When do you unlock Lucia in GTA 6?
Lucia becomes playable near the end of Chapter 1, after roughly 16% of the game. Most players reach that point after about 10 hours. Her first mission alongside Jason is Day Release, the 16th mission of the chapter, as shown in the full GTA 6 chapters and missions list.
Before that, she has to leave prison. After the prologue, Lucia is held at The Hamlet Correctional Facility while Jason works through his early jobs in the Leonida Keys. Her release comes in Coming Home, when Jason drives to the facility to pick her up and bring her back.
How to unlock Lucia in GTA 6
There is no shortcut to unlocking Lucia, as her return is tied to story progress. Players need to complete Jason’s opening missions in order until the game moves to Coming Home.
Finish the prologue as Lucia
Play through Jason’s early Chapter 1 missions, including Pipework and Hey Arnold!
Complete Coming Home, where Jason collects Lucia from prison
Continue the story until Day Release, Lucia’s first playable mission with Jason
Spending time on side activities and exploring between missions also moves the story toward her release. Jason’s early jobs introduce several side characters, including Mandy, the tenant he meets in Pipework, before the story brings Lucia back.
Why Lucia is not fully playable right away
Lucia leaves prison on house arrest and wears an ankle monitor, which limits where she can go. That restriction is part of the story, and it keeps her tied to the safehouse for a period after Coming Home. Players are still mostly in control of Jason during this part of Chapter 1.
Fans have also been comparing her appearance in the finished game with the first trailer, a debate covered in our look at Lucia in the trailer and the final game.
When can you switch between Jason and Lucia?
Character switching opens only after Chapter 1 ends. It unlocks fully in Chapter 2, around 15 hours into the game, and the mission Breakfast Run teaches players how it works.
To switch, hold Right on the D-Pad and press L1 or R1 on PS5, or LB or RB on Xbox Series X|S, depending on which character you want. Some missions can only be started by one character, and the game shows which one is needed. Players new to the series can find more help in the best GTA 6 tips and tricks for beginners, and anyone who wants to revisit Lucia’s early scenes should keep a manual save, since GTA 6 has no mission replay. Rockstar lists both protagonists on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

items.title: GTA 6’s Record MetaCritic Score Stays, Maintains GOAT Status
US Congressman Says Parents Who Let Children Play GTA 6 Are Bad Parents
items.content:
US Republican congressman Tim Burchett has said parents who let their children play Grand Theft Auto VI are bad parents, reviving a long running political argument over violent video games on the eve of the game’s release. The Tennessee lawmaker claimed the game “desensitises kids” and described it as a “how-to video” for committing crime.
Burchett made the remarks to reporters on 18 November, including in an interview with TMZ, hours before GTA 6 unlocked worldwide. When asked directly whether a parent who allows a child to play the game is a bad parent, he replied, “I believe so.”
Tim Burchett is not a fan of GTA VI. He tells @jacob_wass that parents who let their kids play the game need to raise their children “better.” pic.twitter.com/RA1a0L882Y
— TMZ (@TMZ) November 18, 2026
What Tim Burchett said about GTA 6
Burchett argued that games like GTA 6 harm children over time and pointed to “study after study” as support for his view. He said parents “need to start raising their children” and suggested that those who allow young players access to the game should raise them “better.”
The congressman also accepted that there is little he can do to stop children from playing. He said there is limited appetite in Congress to pass laws on moral questions such as video game content, which leaves the decision with families rather than lawmakers.
Burchett has represented Tennessee’s 2nd congressional district, based in Knoxville, since 2019. He is known for outspoken comments on cultural issues, and his GTA 6 remarks spread quickly across gaming and political circles on launch eve.
GTA 6 is rated for adults, not children
GTA 6 carries an M for Mature 17+ rating from the ESRB in the United States and a PEGI 18 rating in the UK and Europe. The ESRB lists seven content descriptors for the game: Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. Australia and New Zealand classify it R18.
Those ratings mean the game is not intended for children in any of its major markets. The same content has already caused problems for creators, with several GTA 6 streamers receiving YouTube warnings over in game nudity within hours of launch. Every mainline Grand Theft Auto since GTA III has carried the top consumer rating in North America.
The ESRB’s ratings guide explains each descriptor, and console makers offer parental controls that block games above a chosen rating. Those tools let parents restrict GTA 6 without any change in the law.
What research says about video games and violence
Burchett’s central claim, that violent games lead to real world violence, is not supported by the main body of research. In 2020, the American Psychological Association updated its position to state there is “insufficient scientific evidence” for a causal link between violent video games and violent behaviour. The APA warned against blaming games for acts such as mass shootings.
The same research does find a small, reliable link between violent games and aggressive outcomes such as yelling and pushing. Some researchers, including psychologist Brad Bushman, argue the effect deserves more weight, while others say the findings do not extend to serious violence. The debate over desensitisation, the specific concern Burchett raised, remains open among academics.
Rockstar has also framed GTA 6 differently from earlier entries. The studio has said the game is the first in the series to encourage empathy, and it uses a Criminal Profile that tracks how violent a player is.
A familiar fight for Grand Theft Auto
Grand Theft Auto has faced political criticism for more than two decades. In the 2000s, lawyer Jack Thompson led campaigns against the series, and in 2005 the Hot Coffee controversy forced GTA San Andreas to be rerated from Mature to Adults Only. In 2019, President Donald Trump blamed violent video games after mass shootings in Texas and Ohio.
In 2011, the US Supreme Court ruled in Brown v. Entertainment Merchants Association that video games are protected speech under the First Amendment, striking down a California law that restricted sales of violent games to minors. That ruling limits what Congress or states can do, which matches Burchett’s own view that legislation is unlikely.
Rockstar Games and the Entertainment Software Association had not responded publicly to Burchett’s comments at the time of writing. The game itself launched to critical acclaim, holding a 99 score on Metacritic in the GTA 6 reviews roundup, and it set a new launch viewership record of 7.1 million peak viewers across streaming platforms.

items.title: Who Is Mandy in GTA 6? Jason’s Tenant, the Pipework Mission and Fan Theories
items.content:
Mandy has become one of the most talked about characters in Grand Theft Auto VI within a day of its release, despite appearing only briefly in the story. Clips of her scene with Jason Duval have spread across social media, and players have started building theories about her past. Many of them want to know who she is and whether she returns later in the game.
She appears early in the campaign, during one of Jason’s first jobs in the Leonida Keys. This article contains light spoilers for that Chapter 1 mission.
Who is Mandy in GTA 6?
Mandy is a supporting character in GTA 6 and one of Brian Heder’s tenants in the Leonida Keys. Jason meets her in Pipework, the seventh story mission in Chapter 1, when Brian sends him to collect her overdue rent. She refuses to pay until someone fixes her clogged kitchen sink.
Her dialogue makes clear that she and Jason share a history, and she flirts with him throughout the scene. She also complains that Brian makes tenants pay through a website she describes as looking like it was “made by a fifth grader”. Rockstar Games has not named the actor who plays her or confirmed her age.
What happens in the Pipework mission
Jason arrives at Mandy’s home to find she has been washing dishes in the bathroom because the kitchen sink is blocked. He grabs a plunger and clears it himself, and Mandy then pays the rent. The scene also gives players a dialogue choice, letting Jason either provoke Mandy or defuse the conversation.
Pipework sits between Unwanted Attention and Hey Arnold! in the opening chapter, as the full GTA 6 chapters and missions list shows. GTA 6 has no mission replay option, so players who want to see the scene again need a manual save from before it, as explained in our guide on why you cannot replay missions in GTA 6.
Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?
Players cannot romance Mandy in GTA 6. Jason can return to her house after the mission, but there is no relationship system that lets him date her. The story’s central relationship is between Jason and Lucia, and Mandy’s scene works as a short side moment early in the campaign.
Some players have noticed that Mandy seems jealous when Lucia comes up, which has fuelled interest in whether she reappears later. Rockstar has not said whether Mandy plays a bigger role after Chapter 1.
Is Mandy a serial killer? The fan theory explained
A popular fan theory claims Mandy may be hiding something darker. Players have pointed to a severed finger they say was found in her sink and a cleaver spotted in her car as evidence. Nothing in the main story confirms the theory, and it remains speculation for now.
Rockstar has a history of hiding small details for players to find, so the theory may grow as more people reach the mission. Players starting out can find more advice in our list of the best GTA 6 tips and tricks for beginners, while the Max Health guide helps prepare Jason for tougher jobs later in Chapter 1. Rockstar lists the game’s characters on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

items.title: GTA 6 Sets Game Launch Viewership Record With 7.1 Million Peak Viewers
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI has set a new record for the most watched game launch in streaming history, with more than 7.1 million people watching at the same time across Twitch, YouTube and Kick. The peak more than quadruples the previous record of 1.74 million, set by VALORANT’s closed beta in 2020.
The figures come from Streams Charts’ GTA 6 tracker, which counts every stream with GTA 6 in its title across the three platforms. The launch also beat the game’s own showcase in August, when reaction streams of the extended look peaked at 3.97 million viewers.
GTA 6 launch viewership by platform
Twitch drew the largest single platform audience, with YouTube close behind. Kick, the youngest of the three services, still pulled close to 1.5 million viewers at its peak.
Twitch had the biggest single platform peak for the GTA 6 launch. (Image: Rockstar Games)
Twitch also ran launch rewards for viewers, which helped draw audiences to GTA 6 channels on day one. Rockstar’s earlier campaign of Netflix extended look had already shown how far the game’s audience stretched beyond regular gaming viewers.
Top GTA 6 streamers by peak viewers
Three creators from three different countries led the launch. Streamers playing the story for the first time drew the biggest audiences, with chat and reactions driving viewers to their channels.
HoneyMad, a Russian streamer, had the largest individual audience of the launch on Twitch. Indonesian creator Windah Basudara placed second on YouTube, ahead of IShowSpeed, one of the platform’s best known American streamers.
YouTube backed the launch with its own 24 hour GTA 6 livestream. (Image: YouTube)
YouTube also hosted its own 24 hour launch broadcast, and Indian creator Mythpat joined the YouTube event alongside streamers from other regions. Several of the biggest Indian GTA 6 marathons also ran through the night, adding to YouTube’s total.
Kick’s share of the GTA 6 audience
Kick reached more than 1.48 million peak viewers, a strong showing for a platform that launched in 2022. Some streamers moved part of their launch coverage to Kick during the day, including creators affected by moderation problems on YouTube.
Kick drew more than 1.48 million peak viewers for GTA 6. (Image: Kick)
YouTube sent warnings to several creators over in game nudity, and some GTA 6 streamers received YouTube warnings within hours of launch. S8UL creator Aman shifted to Kick after a YouTube strike removed his GTA 6 stream. PlayStation Network also struggled under the launch traffic, with sign in problems hitting PS5 players hours before the game unlocked.
Streams Charts measures concurrent viewers across all channels with GTA 6 in the title, so the totals include streams of every size. Hours watched and other launch week figures will follow as the tracker updates. The previous launch record had stood for six years, since VALORANT’s invite based closed beta drove viewers to Twitch in April 2020.

items.title: S8UL’s Aman Gets YouTube Strike During GTA 6 Marathon, Whole Stream Deleted
items.content:
S8UL creator Aman received a YouTube Community Guidelines strike during his Grand Theft Auto VI launch marathon, and the platform removed the entire livestream. Aman said the strike came over a scene from the start of the game’s story and arrived without any prior warning. The action also disabled live streaming on his channel, cutting the marathon short.
Aman spoke about the strike to his viewers soon after the stream was taken down. He said other big streamers, including CarryMinati, streamed the same part of GTA 6 without receiving any strike.
What led to Aman’s YouTube strike
Aman said the strike related to an early story scene in GTA 6 that features a woman. He told viewers he hid his screen for the main part of the scene and switched the feed back on once it moved on. A later moment showing a character standing in a bikini, around 14 minutes into the stream, appears to have triggered the strike, according to Aman.
He said nothing explicit was shown at that point and that he had planned ahead for adult sections of the game. Aman added that he had kept a button ready to cut the feed and planned to skip club locations on stream. YouTube issued a Community Guidelines strike rather than a warning, which Aman called unfair for a first case.
Aman questions why other GTA 6 streamers were not hit
Aman asked his chat whether any other creators had received strikes for the same scene, pointing out that the whole community was streaming GTA 6 on launch day. He said every streamer playing the story for the first time would have reached that moment without knowing what was coming. He also said fellow creator Rusher had received a strike as well.
Aman claimed YouTube treats creators with big channels differently because of the revenue they bring in, naming CarryMinati as an example of a creator he believed would be spared. He said he would tag YouTube India publicly and asked the platform either to act equally against all large streamers or to publish clear rules for GTA 6. Aman suggested YouTube share a guideline sheet listing what creators should not show while playing the game.
He also pointed out that GTA 6 is an officially released game that YouTube itself features in its gaming section. YouTube has been promoting the launch heavily, including a 24 hour GTA 6 launch livestream featuring Mythpat and other creators.
Aman’s GTA 6 marathon moves to Kick
With live streaming disabled on YouTube, Aman said he would continue streaming on Kick. He said he had emailed YouTube about the strike on the advice of a colleague, though he was unsure whether the message had gone through. YouTube has not commented on the strike, and it is not yet clear whether the appeal will succeed.
GTA 6 launch streams were among the biggest events of the week for Indian creators, as listed in our roundup of the biggest GTA 6 launch day streamers. Disputes between Indian creators and platforms often play out live in front of viewers, a pattern examined in our editorial on how Indian esports settles its fights on YouTube.
Under YouTube’s Community Guidelines strike rules, a first strike usually brings a one week freeze on uploads and live streams. Three strikes within 90 days lead to the termination of a channel.

items.title: Best GTA 6 Tips and Tricks for Beginners
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI changes more of the series’ core systems than any entry since GTA 5. Police remember what you wear, money can be lost on death, stats fade without training and completed story missions cannot be replayed. Players who carry old GTA habits into Leonida can lose cash, progress and hours of play.
These tips cover the systems that matter most in the first hours of the game, from saving and money to police, combat and character stats. They apply to both Jason and Lucia on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
1. Make manual saves before every major mission
GTA 6 has no mission replay menu, unlike GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. The only way to play a story mission again is to load a manual save made before it, and the game offers 15 manual save slots. Our guide on why you cannot replay missions in GTA 6 explains how to plan those slots across the campaign.
A good habit is to save at the start of each chapter and before each heist. With 93 story missions spread across five chapters, the GTA 6 chapters and missions list helps players see which missions are coming and where a save makes sense.
2. Never carry all your money
Players can lose a large share of the cash they carry if Jason or Lucia dies during free roam or a mission. Keep most of your money in the Floor Stash at a safe house, or deposit it at the bank. Banking opens after the Buck Me mission in Chapter 1, and Jason has a hiding spot under his bedroom floorboards from early in the game.
3. Change clothes and cars to lose the police
Police in GTA 6 work from the details they have on a suspect, including appearance, clothing and getaway vehicle. Wearing a disguise before a robbery and changing outfits afterwards makes escapes far easier. Switching cars once officers have identified your vehicle also helps break their search.
Police in GTA 6 track your clothes and your getaway vehicle. (Image: Rockstar Games)
The trunk of a personal vehicle can store clothing and weapons, so players can swap outfits and edit their loadout without returning home. The game also tracks your behaviour through a Criminal Profile, which our report on how GTA 6 tracks your violence covers in more detail.
4. Train your stats every few days
Jason and Lucia have three core stats: Health, Stamina and Focus. Lifting weights raises Health, cardio such as running, cycling and kayaking builds Stamina, and mindfulness activities such as fishing and pool raise Focus. Health and Stamina gains fade unless players keep training, while Focus gains are permanent.
Jason’s house in Shoeless Keys has gym equipment, which makes training easy between missions. Our guide on how to increase Max Health in GTA 6 lists the best exercises and the items that give a temporary boost before a tough fight.
5. Use stealth and Focus before going in loud
GTA 6 gives players more chances to approach missions and robberies quietly than earlier games. Guards can be avoided or taken down before they raise the alarm, and Focus Mode can be used to inspect a building before entering it.
GTA 6 has the deepest weapon customisation in the series. (Image: Rockstar Games)
Focus also slows time while aiming, which helps in firefights. Players who find the default three dash reticle hard to read can switch to a dot by following our guide on how to change the crosshair in GTA 6, and the Gameplay settings offer Lock On, Partial and Free Aim targeting.
6. Get a car early and keep it in good shape
Leonida is far larger than Los Santos, so a reliable vehicle matters from the start. Stealing cars works differently in GTA 6, because some vehicles carry trackers that can lead police to you. Vehicle damage can also affect handling and engine performance, so check your car before a long drive.
Customised vehicles can carry clothes and weapons in the trunk. (Image: Rockstar Games)
Players who would rather not drive can use the RydeMe app on the phone to fast travel across the map. The phone also carries the radio, and our guide to playing music on your phone in GTA 6 explains how headphones keep it playing on foot.
7. Explore one region at a time
The map spans Vice City and several wider regions of Leonida, from the Leonida Keys to the Grassrivers swamps and Mount Kalaga. Exploring the area around the current mission before moving on makes the map easier to learn and turns up side activities along the way.
Vice City is only one part of the Leonida map. (Image: Rockstar Games)
Leonida is also home to more than 170 animal species, and the GTA 6 wildlife guide lists where to find them. Players who want to record what they see can use the phone camera and photo mode, both covered in our GTA 6 camera guide.
8. Check the settings before you start
Rockstar recommends checking the settings before starting the story, and GTA 6 has more options than any previous entry. Targeting mode, reticle style, subtitles and display calibration are worth adjusting in the first session, since they affect every mission that follows.
Rockstar lists the game’s platforms and editions on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page. GTA 6 is out now on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with no PC version announced.

GTA 6 Lucia Trailer vs Final Game: Players Split Over Upgrade or Downgrade
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI players are sharing side by side comparisons of Lucia Caminos from the game’s first trailer and the finished game, and the images have split the community. Some players say Rockstar Games improved her character model before launch, while others argue she looked better in the 2023 reveal. The debate took off within hours of the game’s release on 19 November.
The comparison that spread most widely places two near identical shots of Lucia next to each other. Both show her in an orange prison uniform beside a chain link fence, lit by a low evening sun, in the scene that opened the first trailer.
What the Lucia comparison shows
Lucia in GTA 6’s first trailer and in the final game. (Image: Rockstar Games)
The two images match in framing, pose and setting, which makes the differences in detail easy to spot. One version shows stronger contrast, with deeper shadows across her face and richer orange light on her skin. The other has softer, flatter lighting that shows more of her facial features, hairline and the background through the fence.
Her hair, face shape and expression also differ slightly between the two shots. Players have pointed to changes around her eyes, jaw and the way her hair falls, though the scene is otherwise the same moment from the story. It is the opening of the game’s prologue, which the GTA 6 missions list shows as Lucia’s first mission.
Upgrade or downgrade: what players are saying
Players who see an upgrade point to the added detail in her skin and features, saying the final model looks more natural and closer to a real person. Others say the trailer’s heavier lighting made the shot more cinematic, and that the final scene looks flatter by comparison. Several players have argued the gap comes down to lighting and post processing rather than a new model.
Trailers are often rendered with settings tuned for a single shot, while the finished game has to run the same scene on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S in real time. Rockstar has not commented on the comparison or said whether Lucia’s model changed after the first trailer.
Not the first debate over Jason and Lucia’s looks
Fans have compared the two protagonists across every major reveal. After the second trailer in May 2025, players claimed Rockstar had made Jason and Lucia’s faces more detailed and attractive than in the 2023 reveal. Earlier, players had said Jason looked different from the leaked development footage of 2022.
Lucia is played by Manni L. Perez, who earned a Best Performance nomination at The Game Awards 2026, while Jason’s actor missed out on a nomination. Critics have praised the game’s visuals in reviews, and the GTA 6 reviews roundup collects their scores. Players who want to create their own comparisons can use the tools in our GTA 6 camera and photo mode guide.
The first trailer, released on 5 December 2023, remains one of the most viewed game trailers on YouTube. Rockstar hosts it on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

How to Increase Max Health in GTA 6
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI tracks three core stats for Jason and Lucia: Health, Stamina and Focus. Max Health decides how much damage either character can take in a firefight, and it grows only through one type of activity. Some popular habits, including running, do nothing for it.
The game also separates permanent gains from short boosts, so players who stop training can lose part of the progress they built. Knowing which activities feed which stat saves hours of wasted effort.
How to increase Max Health in GTA 6
Max Health in GTA 6 increases through strength training with weight equipment. Bench presses, deadlifts and chest flys all count, and each completed workout adds to the character’s health bar. Players need enough stamina to finish a set, because a workout ends early if the stamina bar runs out.
Jason’s house in Shoeless Keys has gym equipment, which makes it the easiest place to train early in the story. Players also need to train regularly, because health and stamina gains fade if Jason and Lucia stop working out.
Does running increase Max Health in GTA 6?
Running does not increase Max Health. Cardio activities such as running, cycling and kayaking build the Stamina bar instead, and they also burn calories. Players who want more health have to lift weights, while those who want to sprint for longer should focus on cardio.
Focus works differently from the other two stats. It controls how long Jason and Lucia can slow down time while aiming, which pairs with the reticle options in our guide on changing the crosshair in GTA 6. Mindfulness activities such as fishing and pool raise Focus, and those gains are permanent. Players heading out to fish can use the GTA 6 wildlife guide to see what lives in Leonida’s waters.
How to get a temporary health boost in GTA 6
Food and drink give short boosts on top of the permanent stat. These items can push health above its normal maximum for a limited time, which helps before a tough mission.
Protein Shake: boosts the Health pool
Protein Bar: boosts both Health and Stamina
Adrenaline: fills the Stamina bar, slows its drain and buffs all stats for a short time
Health also regenerates on its own, but only up to a white line on the health bar. Players need recovery items to restore health beyond that point during a fight. Stocking up before story missions is useful, since the GTA 6 missions list includes several heists with long gunfights.
Best routine for Max Health in GTA 6
A steady routine works better than long sessions. Players can lift weights at home between missions, eat a Protein Shake before major heists and add cardio to keep stamina high enough to finish sets. Players can keep the radio on during workouts by following our guide on playing music on your phone in GTA 6.
Players who want to record their progress at the gym can use the selfie poses covered in the GTA 6 camera guide. Rockstar lists the game’s platforms and editions on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

items.title: Is PSN Down? PlayStation Network Outage Hits Players Hours Before GTA 6 Launch
items.content:
PlayStation Network went down for thousands of players on 18 November, hours before Grand Theft Auto VI unlocked worldwide. Users reported sign in failures, server connection errors and a “services are busy” message as they tried to get online ahead of the launch. Sony did not confirm an outage, and its status page showed all services running for most of the disruption.
The problems eased later on Wednesday, and the PlayStation status page later showed every service as green. Players who still cannot connect can try a few simple fixes before launching the game.
Is PSN down right now?
PSN is back up after the 18 November disruption, and the official PlayStation Network status page lists all services as working. Outage reports on Downdetector passed 4,000 at the peak on Wednesday afternoon US time, with login and server connection problems the most common complaints. Reports began falling soon after, and the number dropped sharply by Wednesday evening in Europe.
Sony did not post an official explanation. The timing pointed to heavy traffic, as players across the world signed in, downloaded the required system update and pre loaded GTA 6 on the eve of release.
Why PSN went down before GTA 6’s launch
GTA 6 needs a PS5 system software update before it can be played, and Sony released it the day before launch. Millions of players downloading that update at the same time as their game files put extra load on the network. The game reportedly needs PS5 firmware 14.22, and PlayStation told players on X that the update had to be installed before playing.
The rush grew further as GTA 6 went live region by region at midnight local time. Players outside New Zealand also tried the New Zealand trick to play GTA 6 early, which sends more sign ins to the network than a normal launch day.
Can you play GTA 6 if PSN is down?
GTA 6’s story mode is a single player game, so players with a fully installed copy and the latest system update can usually start it offline. Digital copies may still need to verify the licence, which requires a connection the first time unless the PS5 is set as the primary console. Setting the console as primary through the Console Sharing and Offline Play option avoids that check.
Indian players unlocked GTA 6 at midnight IST on 19 November, after the disruption had eased. Full timings by region are in our guide to the GTA 6 release time in India.
How to fix PSN sign in errors on PS5
Players still seeing errors should check the PlayStation status page first, because a confirmed outage cannot be fixed at home. If every service shows green, restarting the PS5 and the router clears most sign in problems. Running the Test Internet Connection tool under Network settings confirms whether the console can reach PSN.
Signing out and back into the PlayStation account can also reset a stuck session. More updates from launch day, including server problems and early player reports, are in our GTA 6 launch live blog.

How to Change the Time of Day in GTA 6
items.content:
Time in Grand Theft Auto VI moves far more slowly than in earlier Rockstar games, so waiting for night or sunrise in Leonida can take a long stretch of real play. Some activities and moments suit a particular time of day, from Vice City’s nightlife to sunset drives along the coast. The game gives players one way to move the clock forward on demand.
Some story missions also change the time automatically when they start or end. Outside those, the clock keeps running in the open world until players choose to skip ahead.
How to change the time of day in GTA 6
Players change the time of day in GTA 6 by sleeping at a safehouse. When Jason or Lucia goes to sleep, the game lets players choose the time they want to wake up, and the clock jumps to that point.
Travel to any safehouse you have unlocked
Go to the bed and choose the option to sleep
Pick the time of day you want to skip to
Wake up at the new time and continue playing
Sleeping also gives Jason and Lucia a buff that helps their health and Focus. That makes a nap before a big mission useful even when the time of day does not matter, and it pairs well with the training routine in our guide on how to increase Max Health in GTA 6.
How long is a day in GTA 6?
A full day and night in GTA 6 lasts about 144 minutes of real time, based on gameplay footage that shows one in game minute passing every six seconds. That is three times longer than the 48 minute cycle in GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar Games has not published an official figure.
At that pace, daylight and night each last roughly 72 minutes. Waiting for night without sleeping could take more than an hour, which is why the safehouse option matters for players chasing night only activities.
Sleeping at a safehouse lets players skip straight to Vice City’s nightlife. (Image: Rockstar Games)
When to skip time in GTA 6
Skipping time helps when a mission, contact or activity is only available at certain hours. It also helps players line up the light they want for photos, since a golden hour shot looks very different from a midday one. Our GTA 6 camera guide covers photo mode settings such as exposure and lens flare that work best at sunrise and sunset.
Time of day can also affect where animals appear, as some wildlife is more active at night or around dawn. Players hunting or fishing can check the GTA 6 wildlife guide before choosing when to head out. New players can find more early game advice in our list of the best GTA 6 tips and tricks for beginners.
Can you change the weather in GTA 6?
Sleeping changes the clock, but GTA 6 has no option to pick the weather. Leonida’s weather system runs on its own and includes tropical storms, so players who want clear skies have to wait for conditions to change. Rockstar lists the game’s features on its official Grand Theft Auto VI page.

items.title: GTA 6 Camera Guide: How to Take Selfies, Change Filters and Use Photo Mode
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI gives players two ways to capture Leonida: a camera app on Jason and Lucia’s in game phones and a full photo mode in the pause menu. The phone camera handles quick shots and selfies with poses and expressions, while photo mode offers detailed controls for lighting, focus and effects.
Neither tool is available from the first second of the game. Photo mode opens up during Lucia’s prologue, and the phone camera follows shortly after, once players take control of Jason.
How to use the phone camera in GTA 6
The phone camera unlocks after Lucia’s prologue, when the story switches to Jason. The camera app sits on the phone’s home screen alongside apps such as Messages and Scooter Bros.
Press Up on the D-Pad to bring up the phone
Open Camera, the third icon in the first row
Frame your shot with the rear camera, which is selected by default
Use Zoom, Filter or Light to adjust the image
Select Take Photo to capture it
The rear camera includes a flash toggle, a 3×3 grid, zoom up to 5x and up to 17 filters. Photos can be viewed afterwards through the Gallery option inside the camera app.
How to take selfies in GTA 6
Players switch to selfie mode by choosing the Selfie option in the camera app, which flips the view to the front camera. The selfie view adds three new controls on top of the photo and flash buttons.
Pose: up to six poses for Jason
Expression: up to seven facial expressions for Jason
Partner Pose: a pose option for selfies with a partner in frame
Choosing Rear Camera switches the view back to normal photos. Jason and Lucia have separate phones, and the number of poses and expressions confirmed so far applies to Jason.
How to change filters in GTA 6
Filters are applied before a photo is taken. In the rear camera, players open the Filter option and cycle through up to 17 looks, then take the shot with the filter in place. Photo mode has its own set of 17 cosmetic filters under its Overlays menu, which can be combined with a vignette and colour isolation.
How to use GTA 6 photo mode
Photo mode is available from the moment players control Lucia in the prologue. Players pause the game with the Options button on PS5 or the Menu button on Xbox Series X|S, then enter photo mode from the pause menu.
Camera: speed, grid, roll, eight aspect ratios, field of view up to 48.5 degrees, depth of field, aperture, focus distance, focus guide and an option to hide Jason or Lucia
Effects: exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, saturation, sharpness, grain, temperature, tint, gamma, lens flare, bloom and chromatic aberration
Lighting: up to five extra light sources
Overlays: gameplay effects, 17 filters, vignette and colour isolation
Players setting up the rest of their game can also read how to change the weapon crosshair in GTA 6 and how to play music on your phone in GTA 6. Leonida’s animals make good photo subjects, and our GTA 6 wildlife guide lists where to find them, while the GTA 6 chapters and missions list covers the full story. Rockstar shares official screenshots on its Grand Theft Auto VI page.

How to Change Weapon Crosshair in GTA 6
items.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI uses a three dash crosshair by default, which some players find harder to read than the single dot from GTA 5. Rockstar Games has included several reticle options in the game’s settings, covering the shape, size, visibility and hit markers.
The options sit inside the UI settings rather than the gameplay or controller menus, so they are easy to miss on a first look. The settings work the same way on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
How to change the crosshair in GTA 6
The crosshair settings are listed under the Reticle section of the UI tab. Changes apply as soon as players close the menu, so they can test each shape and return to the settings if it does not suit them.
Press the Options button on PS5 or the Menu button on Xbox to pause the game
Open Settings at the end of the pause menu
Select the UI tab
Scroll to the bottom to find the Reticle section
Change Reticle Shape and any other option you want
All GTA 6 reticle settings explained
The Reticle section has six options. Reticle Shape decides the look of the crosshair, while the visibility sliders control how strongly it shows on screen when a weapon is held or aimed.
Reticle Shape: Complex, Simple, Dot or None
Reticle Size: Default or Large
Reticle Hit Markers: Yes or No
Equipped Reticle Visibility: 1 to 10
Aiming Reticle Visibility: 1 to 10
Reticle Messages: toggles on screen messages tied to the reticle
Complex is the default and changes shape depending on the equipped weapon. Simple and Dot use a smaller marker that stays the same across weapons, which is closer to the GTA 5 style. None removes the crosshair entirely, an option players can pair with a realistic aiming setup.
Hit markers add a brief signal on the crosshair when a shot lands, which helps confirm hits at long range. Turning them off gives a cleaner screen but removes that feedback. The two visibility sliders work separately, so players can keep the reticle faint while a weapon is simply held and make it stronger only when they aim down sights.
Reticle Size only offers two steps, Default and Large. The Large setting suits players on bigger TVs or those sitting far from the screen, while Default keeps the marker small enough to avoid covering distant targets.
Which GTA 6 crosshair setting is best?
Players who used the single dot in GTA 5 will find Dot the most familiar choice. Combining it with the Large size makes the marker easier to see during fast firefights in bright areas such as Vice City’s beaches.
The crosshair also works alongside the game’s targeting system, found in the Gameplay tab. Lock On snaps to targets near the reticle, Partial gives some help, and Free Aim leaves aiming fully to the player. Free Aim with the reticle set to None is the most demanding setup in the game.
Players exploring the rest of the menus can also learn how to play music on your phone in GTA 6. items.title: GTA 6 Eager Beaver and furry PSA leave TimTheTatman cackling
items.content:
With Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) already out in New Zealand, players are discovering some of the game’s most hilarious and unhinged moments. A couple of these moments involve a slew of innuendos and a dislike for furries.
TimTheTatman watches the GTA 6 Eager Beaver commercial (Image credit: TimTheTatman)
TimTheTatman reacts to GTA 6 Eager Beaver video
On Nov. 18, streamer TimTheTatman posted a new GTA 6 video on social media. The clip showed him watching a commercial for the Eager Beaver and reacting to its many innuendos. The store’s customers and even its mascot made suggestive jokes.
A convenience store in GTA 6, the Eager Beaver sells hot dogs, roast beef, milk, juice, pies, donuts, and more. Below is TimTheTatman’s clip of the moment.
GTA 6 IS CRAZY BRO 😂 pic.twitter.com/BInF7CqurJ
— timthetatman👑 (@timthetatman) November 18, 2026
GTA 6 hates furries?
Immediately after the Eager Beaver commercial, TimTheTatman was met with one featuring a character dressed up as an eagle and Great Uncle Sam. While the former read to a bunch of kids, Great Uncle Sam broke through the window and began swearing up a storm about queer folks causing a commotion downtown. The eagle man then flew out.
The public service announcement that appeared after this read, “Warning! This is a message for all Leonida tourists. Hunting season is here, and this year, we’re taking down the most terrifying beat of all: the Furry. Furry activity of any kind is illegal in the state of Leonida, and all citizens are required to report any suspicious activity.”
GTA 6’s announcement on furries (Image credit: TimTheTatman)
The announcement continued, asking viewers to act accordingly if they hear a furry say anything like “uwu,” “rawr xD” or “hewwo.”
TimTheTatman cackled as he heard the announcer say these words out loud.
“This is insane,” he added.
GTA 6 mentions furries (Image credit: TimTheTatman)
What are furries in GTA 6?
In GTA 6, a furry is a character who is a fan of anthropomorphic animals. This means animals with human characteristics. In real life, there are furries who create “fursonas” or dress up as characters with human-like appearances and personalities.
One example of a furry in real life is professional esports player Dominique “SonicFox” McLean. They embrace furry culture and have a blue fox-inspired costume. This is also called a “fursuit.”
SHOUTOUTS TO ALL MY FURRY FRIENDS SUPPORTING ME I LOVE YOU TO DEATH pic.twitter.com/KR3lm5haUP
— SonicFox (@SonicFox) July 20, 2024
That’s all for now. Have you spotted any other GTA 6 moments that raise eyebrows? Stick around on esports.gg for more GTA 6 news, guides, and updates.

items.title: Huya Turns Its First Operating Profit Since 2022 as Game Publishing Outgrows Live Streaming
items.content:
Huya has posted its first operating profit in four years, as the Chinese game streaming platform leans harder on game publishing and in-game item sales to make up for a shrinking live streaming business. The NYSE-listed company reported operating income of RMB15.2 million (US$2.3 million) for the third quarter of 2026, against an operating loss of RMB14.3 million a year earlier. Acting chief executive Junhong Huang said operating income “turned positive for the first time since the third quarter of 2022”.
The results, released on 17 November for the quarter to 30 September, show a company in the middle of a shift. Total net revenues rose 3.8% to RMB1,752.8 million (US$261.4 million), but almost all of that growth came from outside live streaming. Net income attributable to Huya reached RMB29.3 million (US$4.4 million), up from RMB9.6 million in the same quarter last year.
Huya’s game publishing business is now carrying its growth
Revenue from game-related services, advertising and other sources jumped 21.3% to RMB644.7 million (US$96.2 million), and Huya said the rise was driven mainly by in-game item sales and advertising. That line now makes up about 37% of total revenue, up from roughly 31% a year ago. Live streaming revenue, still the larger business, slipped to RMB1,108.2 million (US$165.3 million) from RMB1,156.7 million, a fall of about 4.2%. In money terms, the non-streaming business added RMB113.1 million year on year, while live streaming lost RMB48.5 million.
Huya’s revenue mix, third quarter

Q3 2026: 1,752.8
Live streaming 1,108.2

Pink: game-related services, advertising and other. Source: Huya Q3 2026 results.
Huang pointed to game publishing as the main reason for the improvement. “Game publishing is becoming an increasingly important growth driver for our business,” he said, adding that Huya is advancing the release of The Legend of Swordman: Reunion and other titles. The company said it is drawing on what it learned from launching the mobile version of Goose Goose Duck. The release did not break out revenue for individual titles, and it did not give a launch date for The Legend of Swordman: Reunion.
The better revenue mix also helped Huya’s margins during the quarter. Gross profit rose 12.6% to RMB255.2 million (US$38.1 million), lifting gross margin to 14.6% from 13.4%. On a non-GAAP basis, operating income reached RMB30.5 million (US$4.6 million), which Huya said was its highest quarterly level since the third quarter of 2022. Non-GAAP net income attributable to Huya rose to RMB43.7 million (US$6.5 million), from RMB36.3 million a year earlier.
Live streaming is still shrinking at Huya
Huya said live streaming revenue “continued to stabilize” compared with the previous quarter, but it is still lower than a year ago. Huya built its business on game and esports live streaming in China, so the live streaming line remains the core of the platform. The Q3 release does not give monthly active user numbers, so it offers no direct read on whether its audience is growing. Live streaming still brought in about 63% of revenue in the quarter, down from about 69% a year earlier.
The broader picture for big esports broadcasts has been mixed this year. Our report on the Worlds 2026 final found its peak audience was the lowest in six years. Huya’s figures suggest the company is no longer relying on streaming growth alone to fix its numbers.
Cash, buybacks and what Huya told investors
Huya ended September with RMB2,927.2 million (US$436.6 million) in cash and deposits, down from RMB3,213.1 million three months earlier. Its share repurchase programme, authorised in March 2026 and increased by US$50 million in August to up to US$100 million, runs until 18 March 2028. By 30 September, Huya had bought back 9.4 million American depositary shares for US$21.3 million in total.
Chief financial officer Raymond Peng Lei said the company remains “firmly committed to shareholder returns” while it focuses on operations. Huya posted the release on its investor relations site and filed the results with the US Securities and Exchange Commission in a Form 6-K exhibit on the same day. The company did not announce a dividend alongside the quarterly numbers, leaving the buyback as its main return to shareholders this quarter.
Huya is reporting during a busy earnings season for the games business. Nexon recently guided for flat revenue despite strong ARC Raiders sales, and Take-Two’s shares have rebounded on the first GTA 6 reviews. Huya’s next update will be its fourth-quarter results, which cover the period to 31 December 2026.

Oppenheimer Sets GTA 6’s Bar at 20 Million Copies in Three Days as Take-Two Stock Jumps 7%
items.content:
Oppenheimer has reiterated its Outperform rating on Take-Two Interactive with a $280 price target, and its launch-week note sets a clear bar for Grand Theft Auto VI. The broker expects about 20 million copies sold and at least $1.85 billion in gross revenue in the game’s first three days, according to a summary of the note published by Investing.com. Take-Two shares were trading at $218.92 at 12:53pm ET on Wednesday, up 7.35% on the day, according to Google Finance.
That price leaves about 28% of upside to Oppenheimer’s target. The stock had fallen almost 12% over the previous week, according to the same report, and our earlier analysis of the rebound covers how the reviews turned that around. Trading volume had reached 6.8 million shares by early afternoon, roughly double the stock’s average daily volume of 3.34 million. The shares opened at $212.64, dipped as low as $201.66 and climbed to an intraday high of $221.83, giving Take-Two a market value of about $40.9 billion.
Oppenheimer’s four tests for the GTA 6 launch
The note lays out four markers that investors can check against the launch as it happens. Oppenheimer expected an aggregate Metacritic score of 97 or higher and a Twitch peak of about 2 million viewers. Its sales tests are around 20 million units in three days and gross revenue of $1.85 billion or more over the same period. It also flagged cyberattacks on console networks as the main launch-day risk.
Two of those tests have already been passed. GTA VI holds a 99 Metascore from 147 critic reviews, which our reviews roundup tracked as the embargo lifted, and that beats the 97 Oppenheimer set as its benchmark. On Twitch, the game’s category page passed 3 million concurrent viewers on 18 November, well above both the 2 million estimate and the 1.82 million peak the note cites for the gameplay reveal.
The sales tests will take longer to settle. Oppenheimer used a Sensor Tower estimate of 15.88 million pre-ordered units as a comparison point, and it said Take-Two could share its first sales figure as early as 20 November. A first-weekend update could follow on 23 November, which would give investors a direct read on the 20 million target.
What other analysts expect from Take-Two
Oppenheimer is not alone in staying bullish through the launch. After Take-Two’s second-quarter results earlier this month, DA Davidson kept a Buy rating with a $300 target, Piper Sandler held Overweight at $290 and BMO Capital stayed at Outperform with $285. TD Cowen kept its Buy rating at $284, while UBS cut its target from $300 to $295 and kept its Buy call. Our analysis earlier this week found an average TipRanks target of $290.50, close to where most of these brokers sit.
Take-Two’s latest quarterly results were not perfect, though. Net bookings for the quarter came in slightly below guidance and consensus, mainly because NBA 2K27 sold less than expected, but Take-Two reiterated its full-year forecast. That guidance, available on Take-Two’s investor relations site, depends heavily on GTA VI’s performance in the final months of the financial year.
Price targets across Wall Street range from $170 to $330, according to the InvestingPro data cited in the report. The stock’s 52-week high is $265.65, and every target listed above sits higher than that level. Wednesday’s intraday high of $221.83 was still more than $40 below that peak, which shows how much ground the stock has given up since that high.
What could still go wrong on launch day
Oppenheimer’s main worry is something that sits outside Rockstar’s control. A large cyberattack on PlayStation Network or Xbox Live during the first hours could stop players from downloading or starting the game, and that would hit early sales. There was no sign of a major outage when we checked PlayStation’s status page earlier on launch day, and our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking platform status as each region unlocks.
The other risk is the weight of expectations around the launch. Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser said the studio tried to make a game that would exceed players’ expectations, and a 99 Metascore leaves little room for disappointment once millions of players are in. GTA VI launches on the US East Coast at midnight ET, and Oppenheimer expects Take-Two’s first sales disclosure as early as 20 November.

Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) launches for everyone on Nov. 19, but players can get some free rewards ahead of time thanks to the new GTA 6 Discord Quest. Here’s our quick guide on how to complete it for free Orbs plus how to unlock the Discord’s GTA 6 Vice City theme, icon, and more.
Key takeaways
The GTA 6 Discord Quest rewards players with 200 free Orbs.
Complete the Discord Quest by watching the video in full.
Do not leave the video screen while watching or Discord will pause your progress.
Players can also unlock the free GTA 6 Vice City theme, app icon, and display name style.
The free theme lasts until Dec. 13 for non-Nitro plus Nitro Basic users and Feb. 20 for Nitro subscribers.

How to complete the GTA 6 Discord Quest
Open Discord on your phone or pC
Press the “Quests” tab
Select the GTA 6 Discord Quest
Click on the “Watch 30+s” button
Watch the trailer in full
Press the “Claim Reward” button
To unlock some free Orbs in celebration of GTA 6, launch the Discord app on either your phone or PC and press the “Quest” tab located near the top-left corner. Next, scroll down a bit for all of the existing Discord Quests until you find the one for GTA 6 from Rockstar Games.
Finally, click on the “Watch 30+s” button and enjoy the GTA 6 video. Despite the implication that the video is about 30 seconds long, it actually goes on for 1 minute and 29 seconds.
Watch the trailer in full (Image credit: esports.gg)
Additionally, note that in order to complete this GTA 6 Discord Quest, you must watch the video in full and not click out of the screen. Tabbing out pauses the video and gives you the “We paused the video while you are away. Resume to continue progress” message.
After watching the video, press the “Claim Reward” button near the bottom-right corner. This should grant you 200 Orbs.
You can then exchange Orbs for cosmetics such as badges, avatar affects, and more in the Discord Shop.
How to get free Discord Orbs (Image credit: esports.gg)
How to unlock the GTA 6 Discord theme for free
Rockstar Games and Discord are also giving players a free GTA 6 theme plus a display name style and app icon. To obtain it, head into the “Quests” tab on Discord and click on the “Preview Theme” button under the “Give Discord a Vice City Makeover” offering. Then, press the “Apply” button.
This free GTA 6 Discord theme lasts until Dec. 13 for non-Nitro and Nitro Basic members. Players with Discord Nitro can equip this theme until Feb. 20 of next year.
The free GTA 6 Discord theme (Image credit: esports.gg)
GTA 6 Discord Quest FAQs
How many Discord Orbs does the GTA 6 Quest reward?
You receive 200 free Discord Orbs after completing the GTA 6 Discord Quest.
How long is the GTA 6 Discord Quest video?
The video is 1 minute and 29 seconds long. You must watch it in full to claim the reward.
Can I leave Discord while watching the GTA 6 Quest video?
No. Leaving the video screen pauses your progress.
How do I claim the GTA 6 Discord theme?
Open Discord, go to the “Quests” tab, navigate to the “Give Discord a Vice City Makeover” offering, click on the “Preview Theme” button, and press “Apply.”
Is the GTA 6 Discord theme free?
Yes. The Vice City theme, app icon, and display name style are free to unlock and can be equipped for a limited time.
When does the GTA 6 Discord theme expire?
The theme expires on Dec. 13 for non-Nitro and Nitro Basic users. Meanwhile, Discord Nitro subscribers can use it until Feb. 20.
What can I buy with Discord Orbs?
You can exchange Discord Orbs for cosmetics, badges, avatar effects, and other rewards in the Discord Shop.

items.title: KTC prepares 31.5-inch 6K Mini LED monitor with 2,304 dimming zones
items.content:
KTC is preparing a new high-resolution monitor ahead of CES 2027. The upcoming M32P2 combines a 31.5-inch 6K IPS panel with a 2,304-zone Mini LED backlight, targeting content creators and productivity users rather than high-refresh gaming.
According to TechRadar, the M32P2 features a 6016×3384 resolution, a 60Hz refresh rate and up to 1,000 nits of HDR brightness. KTC also lists 99% DCI-P3 coverage, 98% sRGB coverage and 8-bit + FRC colour support. The monitor shown so far is an early sample rather than a final retail product.
Connectivity includes two HDMI 2.1 ports, one DisplayPort 1.4 connection and a USB-C port. The monitor also includes a built-in USB hub, along with height and tilt adjustment on the included stand. KTC has not yet detailed USB-C power delivery capabilities or final HDR certification.
KTC has yet to announce pricing or a launch date for the M32P2 and notes that specifications may still change before release. The company is expected to showcase the monitor at CES 2027, where we'll likely learn more about final positioning and pricing.
KitGuru says: 6K monitors are still relatively rare outside of Apple's ecosystem. If KTC can bring this panel to market at a competitive price, it could end up being one of the more interesting productivity displays of 2027.

The Miami Heat Become Vice City Tonight: How to Watch, the GTA 6 Court and Burger Shot Stands
items.content:
The Miami Heat become Vice City tonight, hosting the Milwaukee Bucks on a one-night-only GTA VI court and in a new Nike x Cactus Jack uniform. Rockstar Games promoted the game on X on Wednesday, calling it “A Night in Vice City” and confirming that ESPN will show it at 7pm ET. Tip-off at Kaseya Center comes five hours before Grand Theft Auto VI unlocks on the US East Coast at midnight.
The event was first announced in October, and our original Vice City Night guide covered the plan when it was revealed. Tonight’s version adds the full list of what fans will see inside the arena, from GTA VI cars outside to Vice City fast food at the concession stands. The Heat’s official Vice City page calls it “a never-been-done-before event on the eve of the highly anticipated release” of the game.
How to watch Heat vs Bucks as Vice City
The game starts at 7pm ET on Wednesday, 18 November, which is midnight GMT going into Thursday in the UK. ESPN has the national broadcast in the US, and Rockstar pointed fans elsewhere to the Heat’s schedule page to find how to watch in their area. Broadcast rights vary by country, so viewers outside the US should check the NBA’s local listings.
The Heat will play on a special court built for the night. The team revealed the Vice City hardwood on 17 November and said it will be used for one game only. Rockstar’s own graphic for the night uses the same pink neon Vice City script that runs through the game’s marketing, with the matchup billed as “Milwaukee vs Vice City”. On the court, the Heat go into the night 8-6, riding a five-game winning streak after losing their first four games of the season.
What fans will see inside Kaseya Center
The Heat have turned the whole arena into a piece of Vice City for the night. Some of the game’s cars will be on display on the West Plaza outside, and the arena will play music featured in GTA VI throughout the night, including songs from the in-game radio stations. The team has also promised special game night activations inspired by the game.
Two of the game’s fast-food chains are opening real stands. Burger Shot will serve at sections 105, 120, 308 and 324, and Cluckin’ Bell is at section 325, according to the Heat’s event page. The team’s own joke on the listing warns fans to grab their food “before somebody eats your order.”
The players will wear the Nike x Cactus Jack “Vice City” uniform, made with Travis Scott’s label, which we covered when the limited-edition jerseys were revealed. The Heat’s page says the uniform goes on sale at the arena tonight, while the exact version the players wear is listed as on court only. The wider Cactus Jack collection also launches tonight, with two arena-exclusive styles. Scott’s name is everywhere this week, with his GTA VI Air Force 1 Low and a headline set at Rockstar’s Miami festival on Saturday.
The Vice City merch and the rest of Miami’s launch week
Fans who cannot get to the arena can still buy from the Court Culture Vice City collection at the Miami Heat Store, both in person and online. The range runs from a $45 “I Love Vice City” crop top to a $168 satin bomber made with The Wild Collective. It also includes a New Era 9FIFTY snapback at $50, three $55 T-shirts and a $120 “Welcome To Vice City” neon sign.
Tonight is the first of two big Miami events this week. Rockstar and PlayStation are staging GTA VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood on Saturday, 21 November, with Travis Scott, Cardi B and Metro Boomin on the bill and ticket proceeds going to local charities. Rockstar’s festival page lists the full line-up and entry rules.
The launch itself follows straight after tonight’s game. GTA VI has already gone live across much of Asia and the Pacific, and our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking each region as it unlocks. GTA VI goes live on the US East Coast at midnight ET and on the West Coast three hours later. The Heat return to their normal court for their next home game, against the Oklahoma City Thunder on 22 November.

items.title: GTA 6 Streamers Are Getting YouTube Warnings Over In-Game Nudity: How to Avoid a Strike
items.content:
GTA 6 streamers on YouTube are reporting Community Guidelines warnings after in-game nudity appeared on their live broadcasts, and the timing could not be worse for anyone planning a launch marathon. Streamer Frag, who posts as @FragDempsey on X, shared a screenshot on 18 November showing his GTA 6 live stream removed under YouTube’s “Nudity and sexual content” policy. His advice to other creators was blunt: do not go into the game’s strip club while you are live.
A second warning seen by TalkEsport, for a stream titled “Grand Theft Auto 6 – Race to 100% Completion!”, cites the same policy and points to a moment 33 minutes and 30 seconds into the broadcast. Both notices are formal warnings, not channel bans, though Frag described his as a ban in his post. That difference matters, because a warning can turn into a strike, and a strike blocks live streaming for a week.
Why GTA 6 live streams are getting flagged on YouTube
Grand Theft Auto VI is made for a mature audience, and its rating says so. The ESRB rates it M for Mature 17+, and its content descriptors include Nudity and Strong Sexual Content alongside Intense Violence and Use of Drugs and Alcohol. A mature rating on the game does not change what YouTube allows on its own platform, though.
YouTube’s nudity and sexual content policy applies to live streams as well as uploaded videos, and it covers illustrated and animated content, including video games. It bans the depiction of clothed or unclothed genitals, breasts or buttocks that is meant for sexual gratification. Content with nudity that does not cross that line can be age-restricted instead, and YouTube weighs whether body parts are the focal point and whether the imagery is fleeting or prolonged.
Live streams make that line harder to manage. On an uploaded video, a creator can trim or blur a scene before anyone sees it, but on a live broadcast every second goes out unedited. Time spent inside a club venue in a game rated for nudity was enough for YouTube to remove Frag’s stream, according to his screenshot.
What a YouTube warning means for GTA 6 streamers
A first violation usually brings a warning with no penalty, according to YouTube’s Community Guidelines strike rules. Creators can take a short policy training, and once it is complete the warning expires after 90 days. Breaking the same policy again inside that window can turn the warning into a strike.
A first strike stops a channel from uploading videos, starting live streams, creating Premieres and posting for one week. A second strike within 90 days extends that freeze to two weeks, and three strikes in the same 90-day period can lead to the channel being removed from YouTube. Creators who think YouTube got it wrong can appeal, and the warning notice in Frag’s screenshot offers both an appeal and the optional training.
For a streamer planning a long GTA 6 run, that means a second slip in the same game could take the channel offline for a week during launch. Many of the biggest creators have already lined up hours of streams, as our guide to the launch day marathons shows. A one-week freeze in the first fortnight of a game this big would cost far more than a single removed video.
How to stream GTA 6 on YouTube without a strike
The simplest fix is to stay out of the places where the game shows nudity while you are live. Frag’s warning came from a strip club, and the ESRB descriptors list Strong Sexual Content as well as Nudity. If a scene starts heading that way, cutting to a holding screen in your streaming software is safer than hoping the moment is brief enough to pass.
Setting a hotkey for a “be right back” scene before going live makes that switch instant. Streamers who want to show the content anyway should keep it off the live broadcast and edit it into an uploaded video, where it can be blurred or trimmed and age-restricted if needed. Anyone who has already received a warning should take the training, since it starts the 90-day clock, and should avoid repeating the same scene.
The rules matter more than usual this week. GTA VI is rolling out region by region, and our GTA 6 launch live blog is tracking each unlock as it happens. Some streamers are already playing through the New Zealand trick, which is why the first warnings arrived before most of the world could play. GTA VI launches worldwide on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.
The post GTA 6 Streamers Are Getting YouTube Warnings Over In-Game Nudity: How to Avoid a Strike appeared first on TalkEsport.

Pick’Ems for CS2 Singapore Major 2026: Prediction ideas and bracket analysis
items.content:
The Singapore Major Pick’Ems prediction game is active in Counter-Strike 2 (CS2) from Nov. 18 to Dec. 13, which is the grand final day. This period is divided into a few phases, connected to the tournament stages.
You need to purchase the Viewer Pass within CS2 to participate in the Pick’Ems challenge. After activating it, you receive a Bronze Singapore Major tournament coin. Place your predictions to upgrade the coin — and receive 300 tokens for each upgrade. The tokens can be exchanged for the event, team, and autograph stickers.
In this guide, we explain Pick’Ems for the CS2 Singapore Major 2026 in detail and highlight prediction ideas for all stages.
Key takeaways
The Pick’Em challenge for the CS2 PGL Major Singapore 2026 is active from Nov. 18 through the grand final day on Dec. 13.
You can submit your predictions for each phase of the tournament: three Swiss-system stage and playoffs.
Participating in the Pick’Em Challenge requires purchasing the Singapore 2026 Viewer Pass.
The Viewer Pass comes in two tiers. The standard one grants full access to the Pick’Ems. The more expensive one also includes 900 bonus tokens.
Successfully completing Pick’Em challenges upgrades your tournament coin from Bronze all the way to Diamond. Each tier upgrade awards 300 tokens.
You can exchange the tokens in the CS2 in-game shop for event, team, and player autograph stickers or use them to craft custom Souvenir weapons.
Pick’Em predictions are usually very chaotic. At CS2 Majors, underdogs often explode with their power while heavy favorites fall short of expectations.

CS2 Singapore Major Pick’Ems: How to play and rewards
Starting Nov. 18, you can purchase the Singapore 2026 Viewer Pass directly in Counter-Strike 2.
Upon activation, the pass grants you the base tier of the tournament coin — the Bronze Singapore 2026 Coin. You also receive access to the dedicated Pick’Em challenge.
For each stage of the tournament, you can submit your predictions.
Swiss Stages: Predict two teams to advance undefeated with a 3-0 record, six teams to advance with 3-1 or 3-2 records, and two teams to be eliminated with a 0-3 record.
Playoff Stage: Submit your bracket predictions for each single-elimination match once the final matchups are determined.
Bronze Singapore 2026 Coin (Image credit: Valve, screenshot via esports.gg)
Pick’Em tokens and how to spend them
Pick’Ems for the CS2 PGL Major Singapore 2026 feature 11 total challenges. They include placing your predictions before each stage begins and making a specific number of correct guesses.
After completing five challenges, your coin upgrades to Silver.
At eight completed challenges, you receive the Gold Singapore Major Coin.
If you complete all 11 challenges, you earn the highest possible tier, the Diamond Coin.
Each upgrade grants 300 tokens, allowing you to earn up to 900 tokens in total.
These tokens serve as currency in the Singapore Major sticker shop. For 300 tokens, you can pick up plenty of Paper stickers at 25 tokens each, or two Foil stickers at 150 tokens each.
Even with the full 900 tokens, you won’t be able to afford the highest-rarity Gold stickers, which cost 3,000 tokens apiece. A Holo sticker, priced at 800 tokens, can be a solid reward for earning a Diamond Coin!
Paper Singapore Major sticker of Team Falcons and Holo sticker of Team Vitality (Image credit: Valve)
Prediction ideas and analysis
Teams ruining Pick’Em predictions during Counter-Strike Majors has practically become a meme in the community, as it happens at every single event. On top of the usual unpredictability of esports, tournaments of this caliber carry chaos caused by high-stakes pressure and a deep desire of each player to shine on a Major.
It is best to treat the Pick’Em Challenge as a fun boost of excitement and engagement with the competition.
In this section, you’ll find a brief analysis of each tournament phase alongside prediction examples. Be sure to take them with a grain of salt.

Opening matchups of Stage 1: CS2 Singapore Major 2026 (Image credit: PGL)
FaZe Clan competed in lower-tier events throughout the Singapore Major season. The roster seems to have stabilized after losing the longtime in-game leader (IGL) Finn “karrigan” Andersen. The signature FaZe magic certainly can carry them into the next stage.
100 Thieves have reached their first Major since returning to Counter-Strike esports. With the legendary players Nicolai “dev1ce” Reedtz and Håvard “rain” Nygaard, alongside Lukas “gla1ve” Rossander as their head coach, the squad has the potential to push well beyond Stage 1.
PARIVISION had impressive high placements in 2026. And also, they dropped rather low at some events. Despite that inconsistency, the roster is still pretty strong.
Team Liquid looked decent at a few recent events, PGL Master Bucharest and IEM Beijing.
9z Team had a hero run at the Cologne Major, and we can expect at least a glimpse of that magic.
GOSH is BC.Game Esports in disguise. With the freshly established star roster, this team can hit high in Singapore! Oleksandr “s1mple” Kostyliev, Emil “Magisk” Reif, Azbayar “Senzu” Munkhbold, and Ayush “mzinho” Batbold are no strangers to high-tier competition!
HEROIC and DENDELE are dark horses, and Stage 1 is a proper moment for them to make ambitious statements.
Other possible picks at this stage include 1w Team, who reached the top 8 at ESL Pro League Season 24. We did not really see them at tier 1 events beyond that.
